content.what_it_is: MATLAB movie script for the FUNWAVE-TVD rain_on_hills case rendering per-snapshot 3-panel frames into videoOut.mp4. Loads dep.out from ../work/output/ (L2, L4); dx=dy=10.0 (L5-L6), meshgrid coordinates (L8-L10). Configures a VideoWriter MPEG-4 at FrameRate 25, Quality 100 (L12-L17) and an 8x12 inch figure (L20-L23); plot window ax=[0 6550 0 1990] (L25). Frame list files=[10:10] (single snapshot; L27). Per frame (L29-L116): loads u_, v_, eta_, mask_ (L33-L36), masks dry cells in eta, dep copy, u, v with mask<1 (L37-L42), computes speed uu=sqrt(u.^2+v.^2) (L44) and vorticity via MATLAB curl (L45); frame time label = files(num)*20 s (L47). Panel 1: pcolor of total depth eta+dep1 with caxis [0 0.5], shoreline contours of dep from -5 to 0 at 0.2 (L53-L68). Panel 2: flow speed with caxis [0 3.0] and the same contours (L70-L85). Panel 3: vorticity with caxis [-0.1 0.1] plus a quiver of u,v subsampled every sk=5 points scaled by sc=50 with autoscale off (L87-L105). Captures the frame via print('-RGBImage','-r300') (L109), stores it in mov(num).cdata (L111) and writes it to the video (L114); closes the video (L117).
entities: hp pcolor handle L55, L72, L89
h_bar colorbar handle L60, L77, L97

equations.ref: frame time = file index * 20 s output interval

unresolved: files=[10:10] (L27) renders a single frame, so the resulting 'movie' has one frame; presumably a leftover from debugging a longer range
the time label multiplier 20 s (L47) is the assumed output interval; not verifiable from this file
vorticity colorbar is labeled '(1/s^2)' (L98) though vorticity has units 1/s
subplot comments at L54, L71, L88 all say 'plot total depth' though panels 2 and 3 show speed and vorticity
frame capture at -r300 on an 8x12 inch figure yields very large frames; commented imresize to 1024x576 (L15-L16, L110) was abandoned
